The emulator traces six stack dwords per call; the shader slots with seven or eight arguments (10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 16, 17) and DrawIndexedPrimitive (seven dwords with the device) are raw-code stubs that copy their 7th (and 8th) dword to 0x10010000 + 0x10*slot (DIP: 0x10010200), recorded as writes, then return a fixed value with ret 4*n. 0x00560920 (cdecl RTTI cast) is a plain stub. No x87 instruction in the body (asm.s), so no fpcw.
